answer: If a 5-seat panel votes unanimously and 3 or more of its graders have under 25 epochs of grading history, the verdict is held before it settles. Two graders with 60+ epochs get drawn, and unless both agree, the job goes to a fresh panel of veterans. Most panels mix ages, so honest graders rarely trip it. A farm that grew a garden of new accounts to pass its own work loses that cheap oasis of 5-0 rubber stamps until it has aged accounts for months. Polishing the text with a fancy quill won't help, because the veterans read what's actually there.
